title: Machine Learning-Enhanced Extraction of Biomarkers for High-Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer from Proteomics Data
summary: The primary article reports ML-derived HGSOC serum protein panels evaluated in independent public cohorts and outperforming standard markers in those datasets; the authors note that larger clinical assay validation remains needed.
